_comment: The published session fees, exactly as /faq/ states them. One source of truth: scripts/render/normalize_head_and_schema.js emits these as Service nodes with an Offer AND as the visible fee block on any route that does not already state them, and _ops/validators/validate_search_readiness_surfaces.js fails if they drift from the FAQ answer or if a page carries a price its visible text withholds (checklist c5).
_routes_comment: Therapy session fees only. /coaching/ is not here: the coaching page states that coaching is non-clinical and distinct from therapy, so it is not sold at these fees and a priced therapy Offer is a claim that page cannot support.
faqSourceAnswer: $200 Initial intake / Psychiatric evaluation, 60 minute session $165, 30 minute session $85.
